methodology.how: Reads a cloud-shape snapshot JSON -- either --snapshot-path, or the latest tarball resolved through s3://opal-313476888478-globgrph/snapshots/latest.txt and extracted to a temp dir (:66-90). Flattens classes_data into an arn-keyed node dict, dropping any node without an `arn` (:93-113); synthesises stub nodes in class IMPLICIT for ARNs that appear only in edges (:116-134); creates the two tables and inserts row-by-row with one execute() per node and per edge (:150-180). failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED 2026-08-27T06:2xZ against scratch DBs under --db-path; the repo artifacts were never touched. THREE distinct behaviours measured, not read from the docstring. (a) MISSING INPUT IS LOUD: --snapshot-path pointing at a non-existent file raises an UNCAUGHT FileNotFoundError from :241 with a traceback and rc=1. (b) THE DANGEROUS ONE -- DB PRESENT AND NO --force: exercised by building a scratch DB from a 3-node snapshot (loaded 4 with the implicit stub), then re-running the SAME command against a 9-node snapshot. The run READ the newer snapshot, printed 'INFO: 9 explicit nodes', then 'INFO: DB already exists ... Use --force to rebuild.', WROTE NOTHING, printed 'OK: Kuzu DB at <path>' and EXITED rc=0. Oracle after the re-run: the DB still held 4 nodes and the manifest still carried the FIRST run's node_count=4 and its built_at. A caller that scores this run on rc, or on the trailing 'OK:' line, reads a refresh that did not happen as a success. (c) PARTIAL LOAD IS REPORTED AS OK: per-edge failures are caught at :172-180, counted, and only the first 5 printed; the run still ends 'OK: loaded N nodes + M edges (K edges skipped)' at rc=0, with the skip count as the only signal. distinguishable_from_true_negative=no is about case (b): a stale no-op serve is byte-identical on BOTH rc and the final stdout line to a genuine successful build. The only discriminator is the manifest's built_at, and the 26-hour age warning that surfaces it (_provenance.py:41 DEFAULT_AGE_WARN_HOURS = 26.0) lives on the READ side, in comp-kuzu's provenance header -- NOT on this writer's exit path. The writer cannot tell you it declined to write.

verdict.why: EVERY ROW MEASURED, so this is not INCOMPLETE -- it is a verdict about the resource. UNSOUND is scoped to STANDING AS LOAD-BEARING SUBSTRATE and is NOT a claim the script is broken: exercised with --force it builds correctly and its manifest is accurate at write time. Three measured facts block standing on it. (1) SUPERSEDED, corroborated on two independent instruments: four sibling tools carry hand-written 'NOT kuzu_load.py' warnings routing readers to kuzu_nessie_load, and the successor DB is 27,035 nodes at 0.67d against this one's 1,166 at 75.68d. (2) NOTHING FIRES IT: no invocation site across 27,093 files, and the derive-runner container command is derive_runner.py, so the default artifact has not been successfully rebuilt in 75.68 days -- measured from a stamp the writer emits unconditionally. (3) THE DEFAULT INVOCATION SILENTLY DECLINES TO WRITE AND REPORTS rc=0 WITH 'OK:' -- so wiring this into any schedule as-is produces a permanently frozen DB that reports success forever, which is precisely the shape a monitor cannot see. Rule 25 dormancy does NOT fire (75.68d < 90d) and the successor clause resolves this as MIGRATED, not abandoned -- stated so the verdict is not read as an age finding.
